descriptions.description: SNAI proteins are zinc finger transcription factors that act as transcriptional repressors through a conserved domain (SNAG domain) located in the N-terminus of the protein. These factors bind to a palindromic sequence of the E-box group (CANNTG) in the regulatory regions of their target genes.
